title: Video 1: Run and debug a stylesheet

steps.caption: Open an XML file: it becomes the XML context file
steps.note: Shown in the XSLT editor's status bar

steps.caption: Pick a result file location, or press Enter to use the previous result file

steps: The result opens beside the stylesheet
Set a breakpoint: click in the margin

steps.caption: Pick a result file location, or press Enter to use the previous result file

steps: Paused at the breakpoint: the context item, variables and parameters
Remove the breakpoint, and continue to the end

steps.caption: Need parameters or options? Click Edit Debug/Run Task
steps.note: The button beside Debug: the task is saved in tasks.json

steps.caption: Add a parameter to the task
steps.note: Quick Run and the debugger both use the task

steps.caption: Run again: the task is used - here, with a higher discount threshold
steps.note: Pick a result file location, or press Enter to use the previous result file

steps: Run and debug any stylesheet - no setup needed
